notes.title: RELATIONSHIP UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40517126/757bea3b12611471ceb905f31171b8cba7fcf177.jpg[/img]

Hello, fellow hogmasters! How are you all doing?

This time, last year, Hogvalord has made its first appearance. Certainly simple and humble at first, but with the help of our little community, this title kept growing little by little. Thanks to that, we are able to be here to celebrate the second summer. And we just found out something surprising about summer. That, according to Wikipedia, there are at least eight songs with the title "Summer Love" dating back to 1957. So, summer is a season of love, too, huh? Well, we are not sure about that. But we will take it as a good excuse to bring up our most expected update: RELATIONSHIP! Yay!

[h3]PATCH HIGHLIGHT[/h3]

You have been working hard day after day since Early Access. You feel like you are a workaholic even in a game...  Hold on, that's not our intention. We support work-life balance!  So, let's take a break from the ranch, roam around the village and try to befriend someone.
[list]
[*] You can now interact with Patricia - the young lady next door. It's not a hide and seek game, but you can only find her at some certain places, in some certain time of the day, and in a certain kind of weather.
[*] Giving gifts to grow the relationship. Note that there are gifts that make them go yay, and gifts that just "mmm-okay". Gifting the right items will help raise the heart bar faster.
[*] When you reach a certain point of the heart bar, you will be able to trigger heart events that will strengthen the bond between you and your crush. Heart events are special scenes or back stories that the NPC normally doesn't share. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40517126/8a019f03f125ff49333b740c3d2897fb77bee1f5.gif[/img]

[h3]FIXED BUGS:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Can't harvest honeycomb from Bee House in the following days if the player does not go to other locations.
[*] The flower has a weird shape caused by the shader error.
[/list]
Have a great summer time and happy romancing!

Again, thank you for supporting us by either choosing Hogvalord to play or giving us precious feedback. We truly appreciate it and will keep trying to make this game a pleasant experience.

notes.title: NEW UPDATE IS COMING: RELATIONSHIP!
notes.content:
Hello fellow ranchers, 

It's  almost a year since Hogvalord was out. The gameplay was really simple and straight to the point in the early days. You move back to your hometown. Receiving an abandoned land. Spending some sweat, blood (maybe tears too) to get your startup pig farm running. Fighting monsters or whoever trespass your land. Playing witchcraft with the piggies. Growing your own veggies. And recently, a feature to build and enter your own house to sleep and avoid monsters. That's pretty much everything one would do to settle down, you might think. But wait, that isn't the end. 

It's time for something even more joyful and meaningful. Do you wanna build a relationship with the people around your land? Befriend someone, becoming closer, and even falling in love? We know everyone loves to have this feature badly. That's why, we are working on it. Stay tuned for this summer guys! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40517126/f1f646abe9b61c0cb544c6aade306b00b1b08708.jpg[/img]

notes.title: HOME SWEET HOME UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello, fellow hogmasters! How are you all doing? We are back with another exciting content this time.  

[h3]PATCH HIGHLIGHT[/h3]

It's been almost half a year since Hogvalord was released in Early Access.  For people who have tried this title since the very beginning, you could tell that this isn't a usual farming game. It's tough in many ways. A limited number of items provided by the local merchant, energy points that dropping after each task you performed, tricky monsters, nightly harassment on your own land, etc. We know that not everyone is a fan of action and survival. Some of us prefer a relaxing and tranquil gameplay, like most pure farming games would offer. Hence, that's the meaning of this update: to let you play the game however you favor.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40517126/7039159e4ccff94b14fb2eec875a007ceb4a1637.gif[/img]

Unlike the tent, a house provides you with a shelter that completely protects you from monsters at night. While you are inside a house, outside time is stopped, as well as no one can disturb your beauty sleep. There are two modes: nap to recover energy or sleep until the next morning. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40517126/344d8da0f54cde750a2f09ce85f2dd1720fc013e.gif[/img]

To build a house, you need to purchase a blueprint from the village merchant and have 100 woods and 100 stones in your inventory.

Again, thank you for supporting us by either choosing Hogvalord to play or giving us precious feedback. We truly appreciate it and will keep trying to make this game a pleasant experience.

notes.title: Development Small Talk
notes.content:
Hello there fellow digi-farmers! How are you all doing?

So, Hogvalord is almost 2 months old in Early Access now. We are still a bit far from a fully polished product. But the content is getting richer after each update and bugs reports that we received. From small little ones to big bad ones that make us want to faint at first sight. And as always, we would like to shout out a big thanks for taking the trouble and getting back to us!

That said, we want to make it clear that, during this Early Access period, we are still a work-in-progress product, so please bear with us that bugs and beasts might appear somewhere, anywhere after a new update. But rest assured, we won't leave you hanging. 

If you run into any trouble, don't hesitate to poke us here on Steam or anywhere else that you see us, FB/ Twitter/ website/ etc. We will either provide a fast hotfix, or fixing it directly on your save file. You can send it to us through hogvalord@gmail.com 

In case you wonder where is the save file, and how to report:

[previewyoutube=nTnQ4mUhKXo;full][/previewyoutube]

Description and screenshots of the bug would be much appreciated!
 
[h3]UPCOMING UPDATE (14th Aug)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Our merchant is ordering a new weapon for you, he can't stand seeing you torn and scratched like a rag every single day.
[*] You need more honey to heal. But wild bees are too wild?  How about homemade bees?
[*] Tired of mouse clicking? Don't worry. Keyboard support is coming! The legendary A,W,S,D 😇
[/list]
 
Before ending our small talk today, we would like to thank you for supporting us by either choosing Hogvalord to play or giving us precious feedbacks. We truly appreciate it and will keep trying to make this game a pleasant experience.

notes.title: SMALL UPDATE 1.0.6
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40517126/f974278de9aa4364f6469b106597edf333bf7b44.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40517126/49bbccc9ca579254668eedf3e460f05d10eb6cd7.png[/img][/url]

That's an important issue that harms the player experience when they try Hogvalord for the first time. Luckily, player Pyr0l didn't give up on me, a solo developer, and his first debut game. I tried to investigate and fix the issue with the log and saved files provided by Pyr0l, but I still need more people to join me in this journey to make a better Hogvalord. Thank you all for your support and understanding.

[h3]WHAT'S NEW IN THIS SMALL UPDATE:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug: trees don't show up on the hill where they're supposed to be. I understand how it upsets you, my beloved players. That's why I tried my best to fix it as soon as I can and never stop until it's gone.
[*] I added ESC to make your conversation with NPC easier. Now you can click on the Continue button or press ESC. This feature does not affect players who play Hogvalord with the gamepad because you already have an "A" button to proceed with the dialogue.
[/list]
- Thap Tam Studio -
